title: 1RB0LE_0LC0RB_1RD1LD_1RA1LF_0LB1LE_---1LB: trips classified by the residue of the first block
text: A trip into a word that starts 0 1<sup>j</sup> 0 Z, j ≥ 4, depends only on j mod 3 once its own trips into Z return. For j = 4+3k it is a nested clock; for j = 5+3m it becomes a short clock and leaves with 1<sup>7</sup> in front; for j = 6+3m it turns back and leaves in state B. Proved in Lean for every m, Z and L. So such a trip never returns.
